events.vehicle: E84916 - CDL A DRIVER - MIke Wallace

details.description: Ropes were installed on the elevator door to facilitate opening, and on the lifting lug to improve mobility
Ropes were installed on the elevator door to facilitate opening, and on the lifting lug to improve mobility
The rig hands as well as casing crew worked well and communicated well to keep everyone on the floor safe
A section of the matting for the floor had popped out and was creating a trip hazard for the tong operator.

As I got upstairs and walked out to the rig floor the rig crew was using the air hoist to set the FMS console. They had lifted it about 15' off the floor to make it pass through between the A-Leg and two stands of heavy weight drill pipe without a tagline. As it passed through the console swung across the floor as the operator started slacking off. The console nearly swung over the top of the torque turn crew member as he was rigging up his equipment but I was able to pull him back out of the way.
The tong spring cable was not installed properly onto the crissbar of the tongs.
After pulling he ings onto the casing I observed the crew member lay his hand on top of the tongs.
When we set slips they were set a little to low to where the collar clamp was sitting on the handle of the slips and could've possibly broken them or caused more issues
Guys did amazing job everyone worked safe
The 13 3/8" casing run was successfully executed, with tools assembled safely and the work performed to a high standard, without incident.
Early morning today its dark and while driving I came up to a metal barrel on the road.  New one full of some fluid for farming.   I roll it off the road so no one ran in to it.
